confirmedFindings.title: Hardcoded context.Background() ignores request cancellation lifecycle
confirmedFindings.body: Passing context.Background() into NewRequestWithContext ignores caller cancellation signals and timeouts, causing orphaned outbound HTTP requests when clients disconnect.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Pass the incoming ctx parameter to http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", ...)
